tools.name: get_domain_architecture
tools.description: Complete InterPro domain architecture for one or more UniProt proteins. For each UniProt accession (e.g. "P04637"), returns every matching InterPro entry — accession, name, type (family/domain/repeat/site), member-database signatures (Pfam, PANTHER, SMART, PROSITE, CDD, ...), and the entry's fragment coordinates on the protein. Pagination is followed to completion and verified against the API's count, so large multi-domain proteins are never silently truncated. Use this for the protein->domains direction (includes all Pfam domain annotations for a protein). For the entry->proteins direction use search_interpro_entries / get_pfam_family_proteins.
tools.returns: Returns {"summaries": {accession: {protein, protein_length, entry_count, entries: [...]}, ...}, "stats": {http_requests, bytes_downloaded}}. Absent location keys mean model=null, score=null, representative=false, fragment dc_status="CONTINUOUS".

tools.name: get_interpro_entry
tools.description: Detail record for an InterPro entry (IPRxxxxxx) or Pfam family (PFxxxxx). The route is chosen by accession prefix, so this serves both InterPro entry detail and Pfam family detail. Returns a deterministic summary: accession, name, type, description, GO terms (sorted), member-database signatures, integrated/set relationships (e.g. a Pfam family's clan in "set_info"), and counters.

tools.name: get_pfam_clan
tools.description: Pfam clan detail including the complete sorted member-family list.
tools.returns: Returns clan metadata plus "members" (every PF family in the clan) and "member_count".

tools.name: get_pfam_family_proteins
tools.description: Member proteins of a Pfam family (complete walk or count).

tax_id.description: restrict to an NCBI taxon, e.g. 9606 for human.

count_only.description: return only the match count — REQUIRED for very large families (e.g. unfiltered PF00069 has hundreds of thousands of members); the full walk is paced at <=2 req/s.

tools.name: get_pfam_family_proteomes
tools.description: Proteomes containing members of a Pfam family.

count_only.description: default True — the upstream proteome route's cursor pagination is defective for deep walks (fleet-documented), so the count is the reliable product. Set False only for small families.

tools.name: get_protein_atlas_gene
tools.description: Human Protein Atlas per-gene record (HPA release 25.1, pinned host).

tools.name: get_string_best_similarity_hits
tools.description: Best homology hit per input protein in a target species (STRING).

symbols.description: gene symbols in the source species.

target_species.description: target NCBI taxonomy ID; None asks STRING for the best hit across all species in its homology data.

tools.returns: Returns mapping info plus one best-hit record per query protein, sorted by query STRING ID.

tools.name: get_string_network
tools.description: STRING protein-protein interaction network for a gene list (v12.0). Maps symbols to STRING IDs first (unmapped symbols are reported explicitly), then retrieves the interaction network at the stated confidence threshold.

required_score.description: minimum combined interaction score 0-1000 (400 = medium confidence, 700 = high, 900 = highest).

tools.returns: Returns structured JSON: "nodes" (per-input mapping + degree; isolated nodes visible), "unmapped", deterministically ordered "edges" ({a, b, score, evidence-by-channel}), "summary" (node/edge counts, score stats), and a "provenance" request log.

tools.name: get_string_similarity_scores
tools.description: Smith-Waterman protein similarity bitscores among a gene set (STRING). Maps symbols to STRING IDs, then fetches STRING's all-vs-all homology bitscores within the set. "pairs" holds one record per reported unordered pair including self-scores; pairs absent from STRING's similarity data are not listed (sparse semantics — absence means no recorded similarity, not zero).

tools.name: map_string_ids
tools.description: Map gene symbols/aliases to STRING protein identifiers (v12.0 pinned). Every input symbol is either mapped (best match, with preferred name and annotation) or listed in "unmapped" — the two always partition the input, so silent drops are impossible.

tools.name: search_interpro_entries
tools.description: Keyword search over InterPro or member-database entries (complete walk).

tools.name: search_pfam_clans
tools.description: Keyword search over Pfam clans (InterPro 'sets', accessions CLxxxx).
tools.returns: Returns {"count": n, "results": [{accession, name, ...}, ...]}; an empty upstream result (HTTP 204) yields count=0 with an empty list.

tools.name: search_protein_atlas
tools.description: Column-selected bulk search over the Human Protein Atlas.

columns.description: comma-separated HPA search_download column codes. Common codes: g=Gene, gs=Gene synonym, eg=Ensembl, gd=Gene description, up=Uniprot, chr=Chromosome, chrp=Position, scl=Subcellular location, scml=Subcellular main location, ab=Antibody, pc=Protein class, pe=Evidence, di=Disease involvement.

tools.returns: Returns a list of row dicts keyed by the human-readable field names of the per-gene record.
